name: Italy: Sicily and Sardinia

outcome.intro: After studying this section, a student will be able to locate Sicily and Sardinia on a map, understand the climate of the regions, and know the major grape varieties grown.
outcome.certified: After studying this section, a candidate will be able to match grape varieties to major DOC/DOCGs and know the larger region within Italy in which they are located.

rows.intro: Sardinia: Island located south of France and west of Italy.; Sicily: Islands off the southern tip of Italy.; *Locate and identify on a map.
rows.certified: Identify major regions on a map.

rows.intro: Sicily: Nerello Mascalese, Nero d'Avola, Frappato; Sardinia: Cannonau

rows.certified: Sicily:; Etna DOC (Rosso and Bianco); Cerasuolo di Vittoria DOCG; Marsala DOC; Sardinia:; Cannonau di Sardegna DOC; Vermentino di Sardegna DOC
Dry White Wines, Dry Red Wines, Fortified Wine (Marsala)
Know producers if you recommend them at service in the Hospitality and Service Exam.
